result.title: Where Should LLM Agents Adapt at Test Time? In Context, in Weights, or Both
result.summary: LLM agents operating repeatedly in the same environment, such as a code repository, a database, or an application suite, encounter tasks that share latent structure. Experience can reveal this structure, allowing agents to reuse environment knowledge and learn from environmental feedback. Agents can adapt at test-time using this experience through two channels: retaining it in context and updating their weights. These channels are usually studied separately, leaving unclear what each contributes and when they complement each other. We compare in-context learning (ICL), reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards using GRPO, and self-distillation using SDPO, alone and in combination, using a shared online protocol and modular framework. Agents encounter matched task streams, are evaluated on each task before adapting to it, and learn only from their own attempts and environment feedback. We evaluate 14 adaptation mechanisms and a stateless baseline with Qwen3.5-9B on 109 tasks from four environments drawn from SWE-bench Verified, AppWorld, ScienceWorld, and BIRD-Critic-SQLite, using five task orders per environment. ICL provides the largest standalone gain: its best policy raises mean success across environments from 28.8% to 49.4%. Adding GRPO to this policy achieves the highest mean success, 51.6%. While adding GRPO improves the overall mean under every ICL policy, SDPO has mixed effects. Trace analyses show fewer lookups and shorter attempts under ICL, consistent with reusing knowledge of the shared structure. However, ICL also frequently skips inspection and verification for the current task. Adding GRPO to ICL helps restore these behaviors while preserving its reduced environment lookups. These observations suggest that reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards can refine how agents use retained experience, motivating the joint study of context management and weight updates.

AI.brief_summary: 在共享的在线测试时适应协议下，对比 ICL、GRPO 强化学习与 SDPO 自蒸馏及其组合在四个环境共 109 个任务上的表现，并借助轨迹分析说明 ICL 减少环境查询与尝试长度、但也削弱当前任务的检查与验证，而 GRPO 可部分恢复这些行为。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「上下文保留经验 vs 更新权重」两条测试时适应通道及配套的轨迹行为分析，或可为 VLM 推理中视觉经验该保留在 latent 状态还是参数、以及如何监督其使用提供核查线索，但论文本身不含视觉输入或 latent 推理状态。
